review_type: Separate AI visual and portable-reading evidence review
visual_findings: Desktop opening and sources are legible with standard shared chrome and no observed overlap.
Phone title, opening prose and Save control wrap without horizontal clipping.

Phone sources screenshot shows four complete notes and the beginning of the fifth; its continuation is outside the screenshot, not clipped by the layout. Complete fifth-note text was independently verified in both downloaded HTML files.

browser_evidence_review.actual_runner: Headless Google Chrome through Playwright; script inspected, not replayed by reviewer

limits: AI review, not human editorial approval.
Reviewer inspected four actual saved screenshots and both actual downloaded files; did not rerun browser interactions.
Phone is a Chrome viewport simulation, not a physical handset. No assistive-technology, Firefox or WebKit testing claimed.
This approves local visual/portable evidence only, not an exact release head, remote CI or live publication.
